headers.description: FoxNose API key pair, created per environment in the dashboard under Flux API > Access, or through the Management API. Scopes follow the key: a collection the key cannot read over REST is not reachable over MCP either. The key also selects the environment, which is why no host or prefix appears in the URL. Hosted connectors that offer a single token field and always send Authorization: Bearer <token> cannot use this scheme at all; they need a bearer token instead - an opaque fxk_ credential bound to an existing key, issued through the Management API.

private_key.description: Private part of the FoxNose API key pair

public_key.description: Public part of the FoxNose API key pair

headers.name: Authorization

headers.description: Which Flux API to expose - the delivery endpoint serving the collections connected to it. Only needed when the key can read more than one; with a single readable API it is selected automatically. Sending the wrong value returns 403, and omitting it where it is required returns 400 listing the key's own options.
headers.name: x-foxnose-prefix
